annotations.title: Restore identifiers into a local file

description: Restore original identifiers into text produced from a protected session, writing the result to a file inside the server's configured release directory (REDACTA_RELEASE_DIR). Returns only a receipt — file path, size, and counts — so restored data never enters the model context. This is the privacy-preserving way to complete the round trip.

text.description: Text containing Redacta tokens to restore.
